purpose.summary: RTT/1 stability-intelligence engine for mapping, analyzing, and evaluating stability basins across conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
purpose.detail: The Stability Basin Cartographer identifies stability basins, computes basin gradients, maps stability fields across RTT regimes (R1–R4), detects basin collapse, and provides stability diagnostics for higher-level RTT engines such as Temporal Regime Sequencer, Cross-Domain Causality Weaver, and Dimensional Resonance Scanner.

ai.ai_keywords: RTT, stability basin, basin gradient, stability field, basin collapse, structural stability analysis
ai.ai_purpose: Provide stability-level intelligence for RTT/1 by mapping stability basins, computing basin gradients, analyzing stability fields, and detecting basin collapse across conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
ai.ai_operators: SBC-Map, SBC-Basin, SBC-Gradient, SBC-Field, SBC-Collapse, SBC-Stabilize
